name: What is the difference between an interior remodel and a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an interior remodel and a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior remodeling updates or reconfigures an existing space within your current walls, whereas an addition builds entirely new square footage. Remodeling typically focuses on upgrading kitchens, reconfiguring bathroom layouts, or repairing drywall to improve flow. In contrast, additions involve exterior framing and foundation work for expanded living rooms or in-law suites. Choosing remodeling avoids altering your property footprint, while an addition is the right fit when your household has physically outgrown the structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior remodel upgrades existing spaces within your home's footprint, while a home addition builds new square footage, such as expanding bedrooms or building in-law suites.
